story.title: Story 2: Finalization Boundary Between Live State and Archive

result.reviewScopeSummary: Reviewed Story 2 against the story, full tech design, and test plan; inspected the new archive finalization service plus response/environment hooks and live-separation surfaces; ran focused story tests and the story gate; and reproduced a compatibility-bridge edge case in the real in-memory production path.

newFindings.title: Bridge-first user responses still create duplicate canonical archive entries
newFindings.evidence: `ProcessHistoryCompatService` derives bridged `user_message` keys from `historyItemId` (`apps/platform/server/services/archive/process-history-compat.service.ts:61-68`), while `ProcessResponseService` archives the same accepted response under `response:${clientRequestId}` (`apps/platform/server/services/processes/process-response.service.ts:153-168`). `ArchiveFinalizationService` only short-circuits when an existing row with the same `sourceObjectId` is already present (`apps/platform/server/services/archive/archive-finalization.service.ts:70-79`), so the opposite order still duplicates. I reproduced this with `corepack pnpm exec tsx` by calling `submitProcessResponse()` -> `appendFromProcessHistoryItem()` -> `respond()`; the archive then contained two `user_message` rows for the same `sourceObjectId`: `response:process-archive-finalization:history-response-1` and `response:req-archive-4`.

newFindings.title: Story gate currently fails at format check
newFindings.evidence: `corepack pnpm run green-verify` exited 1 in `format:check` because Biome would reformat the constructor type wrapping in `apps/platform/server/services/archive/archive-finalization.service.ts:15-17`. The story gate therefore does not pass in the current workspace.

newFindings.title: Required live/archive separation test coverage is still missing
newFindings.evidence: Story 2's Definition of Done and test plan require proof that live history upserts keep updating current state without creating archive rows. Repo search found no archive assertions in the designated live-surface tests: `rg -n "archive|appendArchive|ArchiveFinalization" tests/service/client/process-live.test.ts tests/service/server/process-live-updates.test.ts apps/platform/server/services/processes/live/process-live-normalizer.ts apps/platform/client/app/process-live.ts` returned no matches, and the added focused tests only cover `tests/service/server/archive-finalization.test.ts` plus archive seed mapping.

Production-path audit did not find fake adapters, shim archive-write paths, or placeholder archive branches in the reviewed Story 2 runtime code.
